annotations.title: Set up your first social profile

description: Set up the first social profile through the app’s owner-bound profile route. Requires manage:accounts, the owner-approved business name and confirm: true; without confirmation it previews only. Existing profiles are reused. An interrupted setup is unconfirmed; reconcile with soclo_accounts_list first.

confirm.description: true only after the owner agreed. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is changed.

name.description: The owner-approved business label for the first social profile.
